title: ModelsResponse
description: Generated from Codex ModelsResponse/ModelInfo. One bare model per base id; the gateway expands provider aliases on the wire. Gateway annotations cover the custom instruction requirement, serde shell_type aliases and nonnegative context windows.

auto_review_suffix.description: Optional introduction to the harness-owned automatic escalation review policy.

granular.description: Optional catalog templates for harness-owned granular approval facts.

request_permissions.description: Optional replacement heading for the request_permissions tool instructions.

AsyncClassifierMode.description: Legacy classifier modes retained for configuration and model-catalog compatibility.

node_repl_policy.description: Extra developer policy for `node_repl` and `cua_repl` reviews.

CodeModeToolMessages.description: Model-owned instructions for Code Mode's exec and wait tools.

deferred_nested_tools_guidance.description: Literal guidance appended when deferred nested tools exist. Missing or null uses bundled text; an empty string omits the section.

exec.description: Instructional template supporting `{{ default_exec_yield_time_ms }}` and `{{ image_helper }}`. Runtime tool declarations are appended. Unknown placeholders remain literal. Exec accepts raw JavaScript; `parameters` is not consumed and its grammar is unchanged.

mcp_typescript_preamble.description: Literal shared TypeScript definitions, emitted when Code Mode Only exposes MCP results. Missing or null uses bundled definitions; an empty string omits the section. Custom definitions must remain compatible with the generated tool declarations.

wait.description: Complete description and JSON parameter schema, selected independently.

ConfigShellToolType.description: Shell execution capability for a model.

ConfirmationPolicies.description: Model-owned confirmation-policy Markdown, forwarded unchanged to actor tools.

browser_use.description: Replacement Markdown for the Browser Use confirmation-policy document.

computer_use.description: Replacement Markdown for the native Computer Use confirmation policy.

CyberAccessProgram.description: Requested cyber treatment for an OpenAI model turn. Authorization and model-tier restrictions remain server-owned.

GranularApprovalMessages.description: Catalog presentation for granular approval policy; the harness owns the policy and lists. This wire type preserves templates verbatim; validation and rendering are consumer concerns.

intro.description: Rendering contract: at most 500 UTF-8 bytes with exactly one `{{ policy }}` marker. Consumers must use bundled text for missing, null, empty, invalid, or oversized templates.

prompted_categories.description: Presentation around `{{ categories }}`, including the fixed prompted-bucket label. Uses the same byte limit and fallback rules as `intro`.

rejected_categories.description: Presentation around `{{ categories }}`, including the fixed rejected-bucket label. Uses the same byte limit and fallback rules as `intro`.

GuardianModelPolicy.description: A complete model policy. Omitted scopes are disabled; unknown fields are ignored. Code Mode wrappers have no approval scope; their nested tools follow this policy.

initial_cua_call.description: Omission retains the existing allowance for adaptive computer use.

other_tools.description: Coverage for tools without an approval category.

sandboxed_exec_commands.description: Whether adaptive shell coverage includes ordinary sandboxed commands.

GuardianReviewMode.description: How Guardian handles an action when the user selects automatic approval.

oneOf.description: Use a current low-risk score; otherwise run synchronous review.

GuardianUnscoredAction.description: How actions outside adaptive coverage affect cached classification evidence.

GuardianV2ModelConfig.description: Optional model-owned defaults for Guardian v2 classification experiments.

async_classifier_conversation_token_limi.description: Reset retained async history when the next request exceeds this token estimate.

async_classifier_mode.description: Deprecated and ignored; asynchronous classification always uses conversations.

GuardianV2TranscriptModelConfig.description: Optional model-owned defaults for selecting and bounding Guardian v2 history.

HistoryToolMessages.description: Model-owned history namespace and public tool definitions.

IncrementalToolMessages.description: Incremental tool notice overrides; missing/null or >512-byte values use bundled defaults. Empty strings omit static text but retain runtime names and instructions.

namespace_instructions_cleared.description: Message supporting `{name}` when a namespace's instructions are cleared.

namespace_instructions_prefix.description: Prefix supporting `{name}`; the namespace instructions are appended verbatim.

IndirectDescriptionPrefixes.description: Plain-text prefixes for Code Mode documentation, ALL_TOOLS, and loaded tool-search namespaces. Flat indirect entries carry these before any per-function prefix. Values are trimmed, and selectors for the same final namespace must agree, including empty values. Empty values add no prefix; unregistered targets are ignored.

mcp_servers.description: Configured MCP server names, before callable namespace normalization. Each prefix applies to all namespaces exposed by that server.

namespaces.description: Exact rendered namespaces, including `functions` for plain tools. Overlap with an MCP server prefix is allowed only when the trimmed values match.

InputModality.description: Canonical user-input modality tags advertised by a model.

oneOf.description: Plain text turns and tool payloads.
Image attachments included in user turns.
Audio attachments included in user turns.

McpResourceToolMessages.description: Model-owned descriptions and parameters for the built-in MCP resource helpers.

cyber.description: Accepted explicit selections. An empty list is distinct from missing metadata.

ModelInfo.description: Model metadata returned by the Codex backend `/models` endpoint.

auto_compact_token_limit.description: Token threshold for automatic compaction. When omitted, core derives it from `context_window` (90%). When provided, core clamps it to 90% of the context window when available.

comp_hash.description: Opaque identifier for compaction-compatible model configurations.

display_name.description: Use the same bare name as slug; the gateway rewrites both fields together.

effective_context_window_percent.description: Percentage of the context window considered usable for inputs, after reserving headroom for system prompts, tool overhead, and model output.

guardian.description: Model-owned approval coverage. Absent preserves legacy settings; an empty map disables ordinary Guardian review. Keys are computer_use, shell, file_changes, mcp, network, and permissions. This does not override mandatory safety or administrator requirements.

input_modalities.description: Input modalities accepted by the backend for this model.

max_context_window.description: Maximum context window allowed for config overrides.

multi_agent_reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort used for multi-agent work when the user selects Ultra.

slug.description: Bare model id in this file; the gateway adds @provider.id only in its remote response.

supports_experimental_context.description: Whether experimental context management may be activated at session startup.

supports_reasoning_effort_updates.description: Whether the model accepts reasoning-effort `configuration_update` items. Missing metadata keeps effort changes on the ordinary request parameter.

supports_reasoning_summary_parameter.description: Whether the model accepts the Responses API `reasoning.summary` parameter.

retirement_at.description: Informational time when the model associated with this upgrade is scheduled to retire.

ModelMessages.description:
A strongly-typed template for assembling model instructions and developer messages.

`instructions_template`: Formerly a personality template, now literal text. The name is retained for model catalog compatibility.

confirmation_policies.description: Replacement confirmation-policy documents forwarded in actor MCP request metadata.

content_filter_guidance.description: Developer guidance after a content-filter block. Missing, null, blank, or values over 512 UTF-8 bytes use the bundled guidance.

persistent_instructions.description: Additional developer instructions for persistent mode. Missing or null uses the built-in instructions; an empty string disables them.

ModelTokenBudgetConfig.description: Model-owned defaults for the context-window token-budget feature.

ModelVisibility.description: Visibility of a model in the picker or APIs.

proactive.description: Ultra-only mode instructions. Missing or null uses the built-in proactive hint; an empty string suppresses the mode message. `hint_text` takes precedence.

MultiAgentToolMessages.description: Model-owned descriptions and parameters for Multi-Agent V2 tools, independent of their namespace. Channel tools consume only the description; their parameter schemas are fixed.

spawn_agent.description: Replaces the static description. Missing or null uses the bundled text; an empty string suppresses it. Generated model information and local usage hints are retained.

NotesToolMessages.description: Model-owned notes namespace and public tool definitions.

approved_command_prefix_saved.description: Optional plain heading for the separate saved-command-prefix notification. The harness formats the prefix list and falls back to its bundled heading for invalid text.

approved_prefixes.description: Supports `{{ approved_prefixes }}`. Missing or null uses the bundled text; an empty string suppresses the approved-prefix section.

denied_reads.description: Presentation with exactly one `{{ denied_reads }}` placeholder for the harness-owned denial explanation, no-escalation rule, and path/glob list. Empty, invalid, or oversized templates use the bundled presentation.

omitted_paths.description: Optional presentation before the harness-owned omission and no-bypass warning. Empty, invalid, or oversized text uses the bundled warning without a lead-in.

writable_root.description: Single writable-root sentence with exactly one `{{ roots }}` placeholder. Missing, null, empty, invalid, or oversized templates use the bundled sentence.

writable_roots.description: Multiple writable-roots sentence with exactly one `{{ roots }}` placeholder. Missing, null, empty, invalid, or oversized templates use the bundled sentence.

ReasoningEffort.description: A non-empty reasoning effort value advertised by the model.

ReasoningEffortPreset.description: A reasoning effort option that can be surfaced for a model.

description.description: Short human description shown next to the effort in UIs.

effort.description: Effort level that the model supports.

ReasoningSummary.description: A summary of the reasoning performed by the model. This can be useful for debugging and understanding the model's reasoning process. See https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/reasoning?api-mode=responses#reasoning-summaries

ToolMessage.description: Model-owned messages for a built-in tool.

description.description: Missing or null uses the built-in description; an empty string suppresses its static text without disabling the tool. Tool-owned runtime guidance is retained.

parameters.description: Complete JSON Schema encoded as a string. Consumed by Multi-Agent V2 tools, Code Mode wait, request_user_input_async (the send_user_message_async catalog key), MCP resource helpers, and Memento V2 tools. Uses the harness's supported schema subset; unrecognized keywords are ignored. Missing, null, invalid or unsupported structures, or a root without `type: "object"` retains the harness parameters. Schema semantics must remain API-compatible. Overrides must declare harness-encrypted properties so their annotations can be retained. Argument handling is unchanged.

ToolMessages.description: Model-owned tool messages and description prefixes.

context_management.description: Memento V2 context-window control tool definitions.

functions_namespace_functions_descriptio.description: Prefixes for individual functions in the `functions` namespace, keyed by unqualified name. Applies to direct declarations, Code Mode, and tool search, including custom tools. Values are trimmed; empty values and unavailable functions add nothing. The trimmed values for available functions plus separating blank lines must fit in 256 UTF-8 bytes in total. This bounds the added text, not the complete definition or its token count. Other namespaces are never affected.

history.description: Native Memento V2 history tool definitions, independent of runtime namespace aliases.

incremental_tools.description: Optional wording for incremental catalog notices.

indirect_description_prefixes.description: Optional guidance for indirectly presented tools; missing or empty adds no prefix.

notes.description: Native Memento V2 notes tool definitions.

TruncationMode.description: Server-provided truncation policy metadata for a model.

Verbosity.description: Controls output length/detail on GPT-5 models via the Responses API. Serialized with lowercase values to match the OpenAI API.
